merchant_identity_binding.basis: First Owner-confirmed merchant candidate for AWIN-01; Owner submitted the join request for this exact programme.

observed_at_basis: Owner-guided interactive Awin session; provider UI screenshots and Owner-supplied programme Terms PDF were reviewed in-session. Exact screenshot capture timestamp was not exposed by Awin.

source_evidence.finding: Kitchen Universe, LLC appeared in Awin advertiser directory while United States of America filter was selected; programme entry showed Product Feed=Yes and green Link Status.
Programme overview described cookware/kitchen products, text links/creatives availability, 6% base commission and monthly payouts.
Programme terms explicitly allowed Social traffic, Direct linking, Content creators and influencers, and described commission exclusions/reversal conditions; paid-search brand bidding was restricted.
Commission Rates page showed Default commission group at 6.00%.
Awin displayed 'Your request to join has been sent to the advertiser' and programme state 'Pending Approval'.

promotion.pinterest_social_allowed.note: Programme terms explicitly allow Social traffic and Content creators/influencers. The terms do not name Pinterest separately; this mapping is to the canonical Pinterest/social permission field at the social-traffic policy class.

tracking.link_capability.note: Programme overview states text links are available and directory showed green Link Status; actual post-approval link generation by this publisher was not tested.

commission.commissionable_action.note: 6% rate and transaction-based commission wording are visible, but the exact canonical commissionable action was not explicitly stated in the reviewed UI/terms.

validation.reversal_return_rule.value: Commission is declined for canceled or unpaid orders; programme terms also list commission-already-paid as a decline reason.

payout.feasibility.note: Publisher payout/KYC/payment readiness was outside MCME-013 and was not evaluated.

rights_disclosure.creative_usage.note: Creatives are advertised as available, but reviewed evidence did not define usage-rights terms.

rights_disclosure.affiliate_disclosure.note: Owner stated an intention to use clear affiliate disclosure, but programme-specific disclosure requirements were not explicitly found.

owner_actions_performed: Owner inspected exactly one selected candidate programme.
Owner reviewed programme overview, terms, documents and commission rates.
Owner entered a truthful promotion message describing organic Pinterest content for US small-space kitchen/fridge-storage shoppers.
Owner personally accepted the programme terms checkbox.
Owner explicitly confirmed intent to submit.
Owner personally clicked Join and submitted the application.
external_side_effect_description: Owner submitted one Awin merchant-programme join request for Kitchen Universe, LLC.
stop_reason: Programme relationship is PENDING after Owner application; canonical MCME-013 rule is WAIT_OWNER. Do not reapply and do not open candidate 2 before MCME-014 decision.
recommendation_for_brain: Accept MCME-013 as WAIT_OWNER evidence for AWIN-01. The record is sufficient for deterministic MCME-014 evaluation, which should classify merchant PENDING as WAIT_OWNER. Do not dispatch MCME-015 and do not reapply.
